newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello says reforms will allow 4 pct-plus growth.
newsitem.headline: Costello says reforms will allow 4 pct-plus growth.

text.p: Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday that Australia was heading towards a sustained period of economic growth that could exceed four percent.
"A real long run where we can lift to four percent and beyond," Costello said, describing the outlook.
"This could be achieved because of structural reforms in the economy," told a business luncheon in Melbourne.
In the government's budget for the year to June 30, 1998, the government has forecast growth of 3.75 percent for 1997/98, up from a forecast 3.25 percent in 1996/97.
But many economists were forecasting growth around four percent.
